create_Gemma3Processor: create a Gemma3Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal image-text inputs
call_Gemma3Processor_with_images_and_tex: call the Gemma3Processor with images and text to tokenize and process multimodal inputs for the model
configure_Gemma3ProcessorKwargs: configure Gemma3ProcessorKwargs with text padding, pan-and-scan, and image conversion settings
compute_Gemma3Processor_multimodal_token: compute the number of multimodal tokens for given image sizes using the Gemma3Processor
get_Gemma3Processor_model_input_names: get the combined list of model input names from the tokenizer and image processor in Gemma3Processor
